_source: Factory reset written by HHKB Keymap Tool 2.0.1 to the virtual HHKB Hybrid (JIS), PD-KB820BS, 2026-11-16 (captures/20261116-223229.jsonl)
_format: 128 bytes per layer, USB HID usage IDs. 0x01 = assignable Fn, 0x02 = fixed Fn (pos 13), 0x00 = none. Position 69 = top-left (Esc), decreasing left-to-right per row; pos 0 and 70..127 unused.
